findings.message: The aggregate KCNA model is replaced by explicit whole-block two-node slot ownership.

verifiedDimensions: All 46 targets and 31 whole learning blocks remain covered by 257 bottom-up slots after 62 duplicate, unsupported, or quota-shaped proposals were removed or merged.
Optional error, boundary, and transfer semantics are present only when diagnostically material; no forced transfer operation or universal semantic template remains.

All artificial neighbor comparisons were removed. Slot distinction is carried by concrete intent, technical evidence, expected outcome, and target-specific ownership exclusions rather than invented competition between complementary actions.
Target, block, node, edge, objective, source-property, domain, mode, deletion, and practice-form projections are complete, unique, and fail closed under coordinated rehashed mutations.

The two whole-node packages satisfy the 120-item floor without padding and retain one coherent Free operating-foundations package plus one coherent Premium delivery, security, and reliability package.
The 60-item 26/17/10/7 form remains choice-only Patternly practice, does not claim provider fidelity, contains no learner-facing content, and is outside publishing discovery.
independentQa.boundary: This PASS applies only to the non-runtime CERT-CORR-03-KCNA candidate coverage architecture. It does not admit content, generate learner-facing questions, claim human editorial approval, or promote provisional canonical totals.
